value_stream.name: Organizational Change Management, Digital Adoption & Transformation Enablement

fields.Owner: OCM Lead / IT Adoption Lead (links to VS-27)
fields.Participants: IT (VS-27), Enterprise Architecture (VS-113), L&D (VS-19.4), process owners
fields.Trigger: Major system deployment (ERP, POS, ecommerce, WMS, CRM)
fields.Volume: Enterprise systems (ERP for ~6,762 users; POS for cashiers; CRM/app for staff)

workflows.name: Digital Adoption Strategy & In-App Guidance (Digital Adoption Platform)

Automation Opportunity: - Context-aware in-app guidance; usage-driven content optimization
Controls: - CTL-634 (ensure controlled execution — Digital Adoption, Training & Sustainment Analytics (PA-134.3).)
- CTL-634: DAP content governance; data-privacy for usage analytics (links to VS-91)
Cross-references: - links to VS-27 (IT), VS-113 (EA), VS-91 (privacy), VS-19.4 (L&D)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Tool-sprawl risk**: DAP adds complexity; mitigated by EA governance (VS-113) and integration
- **Generic-help risk**: Help not tailored to role/task; mitigated by role-based guidance
System Touchpoints: - Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) over cloud ERP/POS/WMS/ecommerce; LMS (VS-19.4); service desk (VS-27.1); analytics (W4091)

steps.activity: OCM/IT define the digital-adoption strategy: a Digital Adoption Platform (DAP) for in-app walkthroughs/contextual help, self-service enablement, and usage analytics across the cloud ERP, POS, ecommerce, and WMS
OCM/IT build role/role-based in-app guidance, smart tips, and onboarding tours, and integrate with training (W4090) and the service desk (VS-27.1)
OCM/IT measure adoption lift from DAP, optimize content, and sustain as systems evolve

fields.Trigger: Change requiring new capability; go-live approach
fields.Volume: ~6,762 employees + contingent (links to VS-98); role-based curricula

workflows.name: Role-Based Learning, Training & Enablement for Change

Automation Opportunity: - Role-based learning paths; training-complete gate automation; new-hire auto-enrollment
Controls: - CTL-634 (ensure controlled execution — Digital Adoption, Training & Sustainment Analytics (PA-134.3).)
- CTL-634: training-complete go-live gate for critical roles
Cross-references: - links to VS-19.4 (L&D), VS-124 (sales enablement), VS-102.1 (job arch), VS-121 (onboarding)
Pain Points / Risks: - **One-and-done risk**: Training without reinforcement; mitigated by sustainment (W4092) and DAP
- **Generic-training risk**: Not role-specific; mitigated by role-based design
System Touchpoints: - LMS (VS-19.4); DAP (W4089); competency/skill matrix (links to VS-124/HR-022); onboarding (VS-103/VS-121)

steps.activity: OCM/L&D build role-based learning (what each role must know/do differently), mapped to impacts (W4076) and the job architecture (VS-102.1), with multiple modalities (e-learning, classroom, on-the-job, super-user)
OCM/L&D deliver training ahead of go-live, certify readiness (training-complete as a go-live gate per W4087), and provide just-in-time support via DAP (W4089)
OCM/L&D measure training effectiveness (knowledge, application), refresh for new hires/late adopters, and integrate into onboarding (links to VS-103/VS-121)

fields.Owner: OCM Data Lead / BI (links to VS-28)
fields.Participants: BI (VS-28), IT (VS-27), HR analytics (VS-103.3), process owners

workflows.name: User Adoption Measurement, System Usage & Adoption Analytics

Automation Opportunity: - Real-time adoption analytics; exception-driven intervention triggers
Controls: - CTL-634 (ensure controlled execution — Digital Adoption, Training & Sustainment Analytics (PA-134.3).)
- CTL-634: adoption analytics aggregated/role-level with privacy policy (VS-91)
Cross-references: - links to VS-28 (BI), VS-27 (IT), VS-91 (privacy), VS-133 W4058 (mining)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Activity-vs-outcome risk**: High usage but poor outcomes; mitigated by correlation to benefit/process KPIs
- **Privacy risk**: User-level monitoring perceived as surveillance; mitigated by aggregation and policy (links to VS-91)
System Touchpoints: - BI/analytics (VS-28); system usage logs (VS-27); DAP analytics (W4089); process mining (VS-133 W4058)

steps.activity: OCM/BI define adoption metrics (active users, feature usage, process compliance, time-on-system, error/exception rates, support-ticket volume) and baselines, by role/site
OCM/BI build the adoption dashboard, detect laggards/exceptions, and correlate adoption to benefit (W4095) and to resistance signals (W4085)
OCM report adoption to sponsors/leadership, trigger interventions where adoption lags, and track to sustainment targets

fields.Participants: Process owners, OpEx (VS-133), Quality (VS-31), managers, Audit (VS-21)
fields.Volume: Per changed process across 200 stores/4 DCs/HQ

Automation Opportunity: - Compliance drift detection; automated coaching triggers
Controls: - CTL-634: process compliance monitored; control reinforcement (VS-133 W4063)
Cross-references: - links to VS-133 (OpEx), VS-30.3 (SOP), VS-31 (quality), VS-21 (audit)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Reversion risk**: Old behaviors return post-go-live; mitigated by compliance monitoring and controls
- **Policing risk**: Sustainment becomes punitive; mitigated by coaching-first and barrier removal
System Touchpoints: - Process mining (VS-133 W4058); SOP library (VS-30.3); adoption analytics (W4091); quality (VS-31)
Time Estimate: - Continuous for 60–180 days post-go-live, then BAU

steps.activity: OCM/process owner sustain the change: monitor process compliance (via process mining VS-133 W4058 and adoption W4091), and detect reversion to old ways
OCM/OpEx intervene on non-compliance (coaching, re-training, barrier removal, control reinforcement W4063), and address systemic causes with OpEx (VS-133)
OCM/process owner embed the change into standard work/SOPs (VS-30.3), performance expectations, and onboarding, then transition fully to BAU

fields.Participants: OpEx (VS-133), process owners, IT (VS-27), users, champions (W4084)

Controls: - CTL-634 (ensure controlled execution — Digital Adoption, Training & Sustainment Analytics (PA-134.3).)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Frozen-change risk**: Deployed change never improved; mitigated by the improvement loop
- **Loop-not-closed risk**: Feedback collected but not acted on; mitigated by backlog accountability
System Touchpoints: - OpEx pipeline (VS-133); IT backlog (VS-27/VS-113); feedback channels (W4091)

steps.activity: OCM/OpEx run a structured post-implementation review (what worked, adoption gaps, unintended consequences, fix backlog) at +30/+60/+90 days
OCM/OpEx feed fixes/improvements into the OpEx pipeline (VS-133 W4052) and the system backlog (VS-27/VS-113), and close the loop with users
OCM/OpEx ensure the change is continuously improved (not frozen), and hand sustained improvement to OpEx (VS-133)

Cross-references: - links to VS-103.2 (EX), VS-103.3 (people analytics), VS-83 (occupational health)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Burnout risk**: Transformation drives attrition/absence; mitigated by fatigue monitoring and capacity management
- **Silent-disengagement risk**: Signals missed; mitigated by continuous pulse and manager input
System Touchpoints: - EX/engagement platform (VS-103.2); people analytics (VS-103.3); capacity (W4074); occupational health (VS-83)

steps.activity: OCM/HR monitor change load (W4074) against EX/engagement signals, and detect fatigue, burnout, and disengagement correlated to transformation intensity
OCM/HR intervene: re-sequence change (W4082), add support, protect recovery, and address root causes; escalate systemic fatigue to the transformation board
OCM/HR report EX/fatigue trends to leadership, and factor into capacity decisions (W4074)

workflows.name: Change Benefit Realization & Adoption ROI Tracking

Controls: - CTL-634: benefit reconciled by Finance; adoption-dependency documented
Cross-references: - links to VS-17.4 (FP&A), VS-133 W4065 (benefit), VS-135 (TBM), VS-36 (governance)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Unattributed-benefit risk**: Benefit claimed without adoption causation; mitigated by adoption-dependency modeling
- **Decay risk**: Benefit decays as adoption slips; mitigated by sustainment (W4092)
System Touchpoints: - Benefit tracking (VS-133 W4065 / VS-135); FP&A (VS-17.4); adoption analytics (W4091); governance (VS-36)

steps.activity: CHRO/Finance define the benefit case per initiative (incl. the adoption-dependency: what benefit requires what adoption level), and baseline
CHRO/Finance track realized benefit, attribute the portion dependent on adoption, and reconcile with corporate benefit tracking (VS-133 W4065 / VS-17.4)
CHRO report adoption ROI to the transformation board/Board (VS-36), and flag shortfalls for intervention

Controls: - CTL-634 (ensure controlled execution — Digital Adoption, Training & Sustainment Analytics (PA-134.3).)
- CTL-634: annual review with Board oversight
Cross-references: - links to VS-36 (governance), VS-30.3 (knowledge), VS-103 (HR), VS-133 (OpEx)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Stagnation risk**: OCM capability plateaus; mitigated by maturity assessment and benchmarking
- **No-learning risk**: Mistakes repeated; mitigated by lessons capture and reuse
System Touchpoints: - Maturity model; lessons/knowledge library (VS-30.3); governance (VS-36); benefit (W4095)

steps.activity: CHRO assess OCM maturity (strategy, governance, methodology, adoption tooling, sustainment, benefit) against a maturity model, and benchmark
CHRO capture lessons learned per major initiative and across the portfolio, feed back into methodology/playbooks, and share reusable assets
CHRO present the annual review to the Board (VS-36), set next-year targets, and adjust the operating model
